text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to the stadium to watch a baseball game with an acquaintance――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Follow, follow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, Rice-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems you have been following behind me for a while now...
If you have business with me, I am happy to listen, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's not business or anything like that,
Rice is just studying on her own, or something...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice wants to win her next race...! 
I want to be able to run like you, McQueen-san. So――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you are observing me,
trying to learn the secret of my strength?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am pleased you think so highly of me,
but the match is about to start――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Match?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
~~Urgh, desperate times call for desperate measures, desu wa!
Rice-san, over here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah!
Knock it out of the park! YU・TA・KA!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueee~...
D-Do your best~~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, that is far too timid, desu wa!
Project your voice from your stomach more...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-Watching baseball is... really intense, huh.
Everyone was shouting so loud...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Today, purely by sheer coincidence,
I merely stopped by for "social study"――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When players compete with all their heart and soul,
it makes one want to cheer for them with everything they have, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I strongly felt... that those who cheer for us
must feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And that I too wish to deliver a run that stirs the soul,
just like their play...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to win for the people cheering for her too.
No matter how painful it is... even if I want to cry,
as long as someone tells Rice to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice can become strong just from that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That is one of the secrets of strength
that you wished to learn, desu wa♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for teaching me...!
And watching the game... was fun too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Truly?
That is wonderful to hear, desu wa♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By the way, please keep today's events strictly confidential.
If Gold Ship-san ever found out, goodness knows how she would tease me――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand...! Things like this aren't
something you go telling everyone, right...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even so, thank you for teaching Rice.
I'll definitely win my next race...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel my intention didn't quite get across, but...
Well, that will do, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, if... if Rice-san ever wants to watch a match again,
I will accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I feel like doing some "social study"
at the stadium again... I shall call upon you as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! When that time comes, Rice will
follow right behind you, McQueen-san...!
